title: Historical performance harness refactor broke the existing current-target control-plane caller

source_observation.environment: Committed 0012 assurance branch control-plane executor regression
source_observation.fact: New-MIRCPPerformanceSourceOverlay invokes Get-MIRPerformanceHarnessFingerprint with its established -RepoRoot parameter. The target-era refactor renamed the required parameter to ExecutionRoot without a compatibility alias, so the control-plane regression failed before any package or Factorio action.

reproducer.expected: The existing current-target -RepoRoot caller remains valid and derives its active campaign target authority, while historical callers provide explicit execution and target roots.
reproducer.observed: PowerShell rejected New-MIRCPPerformanceSourceOverlay with 'A parameter cannot be found that matches parameter name RepoRoot'.

admission.reason: The defect is a parameter-name compatibility regression in package-excluded verification tooling. The correction preserves current callers and cannot affect package bytes.

closure.evidence: The harness accepts the established RepoRoot alias and derives current target defaults only when explicit historical roots are absent; control-plane, exact 2.0, exact 2.1, and hosted exact-head proof remain required.
